description: Impact v2 calibration: per-name base severities re-derived from 19,872 real events (FNSPID 2009-2023), mean |sector-adjusted CAR| per label, anchored to 8.5 for the highest class.
finding: The data disagreed with the priors: firm-specific news (credit, launches, deals) moves individual names more than generic geopolitical headlines, whose market-wide effect is largely the index factor (removed by sector adjustment) and is covered separately by the Module B scenario library.
